reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep Sea Creatures
reading.passage: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions. In the deep ocean, where sunlight cannot penetrate, many creatures have evolved this remarkable ability. Fish, squid, and jellyfish use bioluminescence for various purposes: attracting prey, communicating with potential mates, and confusing predators. The process involves a protein called luciferin that reacts with oxygen to produce light. Scientists estimate that approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures possess some form of bioluminescence, making it one of nature's most common adaptations in extreme environments.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary purpose of bioluminescence in deep-sea creatures?
options: B) To attract prey, communicate, and defend against predators
C) To navigate through the water
D) To produce energy for movement
questions.explanation: 지문에서 생물발광의 목적으로 '먹이를 끌어당기는 것, 짝짓기 대상과 소통하기, 포식자 혼동하기'를 명시적으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What protein is responsible for producing light in bioluminescent organisms?
questions.explanation: 지문의 'a protein called luciferin that reacts with oxygen to produce light' 부분에서 루시페린이 빛을 생성하는 단백질임을 명확히 합니다.

questions.q: According to the passage, approximately what percentage of deep-sea creatures have bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 'approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures possess some form of bioluminescence'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: Technology has made human relationships stronger? Support your position with specific reasons and examples.

structure.intro: 도입부: 자신의 입장을 명확하게 제시합니다. '동의한다/동의하지 않는다'를 명확히 선언하고 간단한 이유를 언급합니다.
structure.body1: 본론1: 첫 번째 주요 이유를 설명하고 구체적인 예시를 제공합니다. (소셜 미디어로 먼 거리의 친구와 연결, 또는 대면 관계 감소)
structure.body2: 본론2: 두 번째 주요 이유를 제시합니다. (의사소통의 편의성 증가 vs. 심층적 대화 부족)
structure.conclusion: 결론부: 서론의 입장을 재강조하고 전체 논의를 요약합니다.

listening.title: Office Lunch Preferences
listening.script: Student: Hi Maria, are you going to the cafeteria for lunch today? Maria: I was thinking about it, but I'm tired of the same old sandwiches and salads. Student: Yeah, I feel the same way. I heard there's a new food truck outside the building. They serve Mexican food. Maria: Really? I love Mexican food! What do they have? Student: According to the menu online, they have tacos, burritos, and quesadillas. Everything looks fresh. Plus, it's cheaper than the cafeteria. Maria: That sounds great! Let me go get my wallet. But first, I need to finish this email. Student: No problem. I'll meet you at the main entrance in fifteen minutes. We can walk over together. Maria: Perfect! See you soon.

questions.q: What is the main reason the student suggests going to the food truck instead of the cafeteria?
options: A) Maria specifically requested Mexican food
B) The food is fresher and more affordable
C) The cafeteria is closed today
D) They want to get exercise by walking
questions.explanation: 'Everything looks fresh. Plus, it's cheaper than the cafeteria'라는 대사에서 신선함과 가격이 주요 이유임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: How long will the student wait before meeting Maria at the entrance?
questions.explanation: Student이 'I'll meet you at the main entrance in fifteen minutes'라고 명확히 말했습니다.

questions.q: What food items does the food truck NOT offer according to the conversation?
questions.explanation: 학생이 언급한 메뉴는 타코, 부리또, 케사디야이며, 피자는 언급되지 않았습니다.
